description: A small white multi-drawer cabinet sits on the table, with a tiny plush keychain lying in front of it. The left hand stays resting on the tabletop while the right hand reaches to the cabinet’s bottom drawer handle, pulls the drawer outward toward the viewer, lifts the plush keychain and places it into the open drawer, then pushes the drawer back in to close it; the cabinet is a right-hand object during the pulling and pushing, and the plush is a right-hand object while it’s being moved.
